component.name: tCam Viewer Desktop
component.summary: Desktop viewer for the tCam thermal imaging camera

description.p: Connects to a tCam thermal imaging camera over WiFi, decodes its radiometric and telemetry data, and displays live thermal video with spotmeter or region temperature measurement, ten color palettes, recording, time-lapse capture, and rolling temperature-history charts — a Linux desktop port of the tCam Viewer Android app.
